style: Soft-dimensional flat illustration with a premium, calm feel. Clean vector shapes with generously rounded corners and no hard outlines; edges are crisp but friendly. Shading is limited to gentle two-step gradients and subtle inner glows, with a single warm key light from the upper left that casts soft, low-opacity violet shadows. Materials read as matte paper-and-frosted-glass: slightly translucent light beams, velvety solid forms, no gloss or noise. Palette is anchored on deep violet and a warm spotlight gold, supported by cool lavender mist and a calm teal for success, on airy off-white backgrounds with lots of negative space. Characters and figures are simple, diverse, non-photoreal and expressive through posture, with oval eyes and blush cheeks. Mood is reassuring, private and encouraging, like a quiet stage just before the lights come up. It is adult-friendly, rated Everyone, with no text baked into artwork and consistent 2–3px-equivalent rounded stroke weight on any line accents.
